scientific_integrity: The infinite-length result is proved analytically by reversibility, discrete Sturm oscillation, a uniform mass-quadrature estimate, and a simple-eigenvalue continuum perturbation. Reproducibility computations check finite cases only; no external verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the specified discrete-time sluggish walk truncated symmetrically at -L and L with rejected outward proposals, not to other boundary prescriptions.
The spectral-gap asymptotic has a fixed microscopic waiting-weight offset +2 and does not assert uniform results for alternative offsets or other spatial hopping exponents.
The general infinite-volume sluggish spreading exponent and general finite-graph spectral representations are established in the cited prior literature.
Independent priority assessment and independent mathematical audit have not been performed.
title: Sharp finite-volume Airy relaxation law for the sluggish random walk
